Question
List all singer names in concerts in year 2014.

{"targets":[{"route":"components","table":"singer","columns":["first_name","last_name"],"role":"output","cue":"singer names","sole_output":true}]}

output.hint: Return this requested person name as separate stored columns in this order: singer.first_name, singer.last_name. Preserve all other requested outputs and filters.

output.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT s.first_name, s.last_name
FROM singer AS s
JOIN singer_in_concert AS sc ON sc.Singer_ID = s.Singer_ID
JOIN concert AS c ON c.concert_ID = sc.concert_ID
WHERE c.Year = '2014';
